name: ghast-waypoints
comment: WP-2.3b. A closed stone box (floor y = 60, roof y = 86, walls at x = +-26 and z = +-14) split by a wall at x = 10; the player (id 0) at (18.5, 61, 0.5) on the far side, the ghast (id 1) at (-10.5, 66, 0.5), difficulty 1 (EntityGhast.updatePlayerActionState kills it on peaceful). For 300 ticks the ghast wanders: a new waypoint within +-16 (three rand draws) when nearer than 1 or farther than 60, a push toward it every courseChangeCooldown (+2..6, a draw) when isCourseTraversable (the box stepped along the course hits no block), else the waypoint becomes its position; it faces the player (within 64) but cannot see it, so attackCounter stays 0. t=300 removes the dividing wall: canEntityBeSeen, attackCounter counts up (charge sound at 10), at 20 the fireball (id 2) 4 blocks ahead along its look, attackCounter -40. The run ends before the fireball reaches the player: new EntityFireball(world, ghast, ...) draws its acceleration jitter from the oracle's unseeded Random (census section 3), so the fireball is not dumped and must not hit anything traced. rng_state and the ghast's entity_state every tick.
